name: PrimeFieldChain.actual_c0_first_cover

name: PrimeFieldChain.actual_c0_reciprocal_cover
statement: theorem actual_c0_reciprocal_cover {K : Type} [CommRing K] (z : K) (characteristic : (101 : K)=0) : (z^6+6*z^4+13*z^2+56)*56^2 = (56+38*z^2)^3+44*(56+38*z^2)*z^4+21*z^6

name: PrimeFieldChain.actual_repeated_finite_fibre
statement: theorem actual_repeated_finite_fibre {K : Type} [CommRing K] (z : K) (characteristic : (101 : K)=0) : (z^2+2)-2=z^2 ∧ z^6+6*z^4+13*z^2+56-37^2=z^2*(z^4+6*z^2+13) ∧ (37 : K)^2=2^3+2+46 ∧ (-37 : K)^2=2^3+2+46

name: PrimeFieldChain.actual_empty_finite_fibre_and_infinity_targets
statement: theorem actual_empty_finite_fibre_and_infinity_targets {K : Type} [CommRing K] (z : K) (characteristic : (101 : K)=0) : (56+38*z^2)-38*z^2=56 ∧ (56 : K)*92=1 ∧ (56 : K)^2=38^3+44*38+21 ∧ (-56 : K)^2=38^3+44*38+21

statement: theorem conditional_two_way_inverse {C T E E2 F : Type} [IntModule E] [IntModule E2] [IntModule F] (n0 : C → E) (n1 : C → F) (m0 : T → E2) (m1 : T → F) (alpha : E → E2) (beta : E2 → E) (forward : C → T) (reverse : T → C) (n_injective : ∀ x y, n0 x=n0 y → n1 x=n1 y → x=y) (m_injective : ∀ x y, m0 x=m0 y → m1 x=m1 y → x=y) (order_e : ∀ x : E, (109 : Int) • x=0) (order_e2 : ∀ x : E2, (109 : Int) • x=0) (order_f : ∀ x : F, (113 : Int) • x=0) (alpha_linear : ∀ (k : Int) x, alpha (k • x)=k • alpha x) (beta_linear : ∀ (k : Int) x, beta (k • x)=k • beta x) (beta_alpha : ∀ x, beta (alpha x)=(49 : Int) • x) (alpha_beta : ∀ x, alpha (beta x)=(49 : Int) • x) (forward0 : ∀ x, m0 (forward x)=(2 : Int) • alpha (n0 x)) (forward1 : ∀ x, m1 (forward x)=(2 : Int) • n1 x) (reverse0 : ∀ t, n0 (reverse t)=(2 : Int) • ((104 : Int) • beta (m0 t))) (reverse1 : ∀ t, n1 (reverse t)=(2 : Int) • ((85 : Int) • m1 t)) : (∀ x, reverse (forward x)=x) ∧ (∀ t, forward (reverse t)=t)
